reason: I do want more jobs and I already live on WhatsApp, but 990 euros up front plus 149 a month is real money when I only take home about 35k, and I could set up an auto-reply in WhatsApp Business myself for free.
objection: My customers want to hear a person, not get a text from a machine, and a brand-new company with zero customers is asking me to pay first and hope it works.
would_change_my_mind: A free month with no setup fee, so I can see with my own customers that it actually brings me jobs I would have lost.
